verdict.line: You win if you only commit your wall-and-burst combo while her Lunge (Q) and Riposte (W) are both down; you lose if you trade autos into an up Riposte or let Burst of Speed (E) carry an extended fight.

brief.thesis: The lane itself is statistically even — EVEN lane advantage, EVEN solo-kill rate — but Yorick sits at 45.6% over 1062 games because every one of his tools (empowered Q auto, E globule, W wall) is a single, telegraphed commitment that Fiora's Riposte and double-dash Lunge are built to answer. This isn't a lane you get bullied out of; it's one you lose by trading on her terms instead of yours.

theirWindow.when: Her E (Burst of Speed) is active
theirWindow.what: Burst of Speed gives her attack speed plus stacking move speed on every landed hit or Lunge, so once it's up she wins a straight stand-and-trade and can chase you down afterward. Disengage rather than keep swinging.

yourWindow.when: Her Q and W are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: With Lunge (16-8s CD) and Riposte (10-6s CD) both down, she has no dash to escape your Dark Procession wall and no parry to eat your empowered Q auto. This is the only window to fully commit Q into W into extended damage.

start.why: Measured as the stronger start into her (46.4% over 715 games, 53.8% pick) — the flat damage reduction on the first hit each trade blunts her Duelist passive stacking off Lunge pokes.

boots.why: Run in 79.9% of games at 46.4% win rate; cuts down the physical damage from her autos and Lunge during the levels where Burst of Speed lets her stay on top of you.

core.why: Core first item in every listed build path; the attack speed and bonus damage make your empowered Q auto and wall-trap trades hit far harder.
66.7% win rate in the Trinity > Cleaver > Shojin path (24 games); the armor shred stacks on top of your E's armor reduction so her Riposte AD steroid matters less.
Appears in every listed core path; ability haste shortens W (Dark Procession) back down toward its 12s floor, letting you re-trap her faster after she burns Lunge.

you need grievous wounds online earlier than Thornmail completes to shut down her passive
she's kiting your wall using Burst of Speed and you need the slow to pin her
she's all-inning off Blade Waltz at level 6 and you need the health buffer to survive the burst

runes.keystoneWhy: Her Duelist passive wins short trades through sustain; Grasp procs on the same empowered auto your Q sets up, giving you a heal-back on every exchange instead of losing the sustain race outright.

summoners.why: Highest measured win rate of the three common pages (47.4%, 36.9% pick) — Ignite answers her Duelist passive healing directly and closes out the kill once you've landed a wall-trap combo.

playing.title: Wall only after her Lunge is spent
playing.detail: Dark Procession has no effect if she can just dash through or away — commit your W the moment she's thrown out Q (Lunge, 16-8s CD), not before.

playing.title: Don't auto into an active Riposte
playing.detail: Riposte parries her next incoming basic attack and reflects magic damage; your empowered Q auto is exactly what it's built to eat. Hold the Q auto until her 10-6s W cooldown is confirmed down.

playing.title: Poke with E through her Riposte
playing.detail: Mourning Mist is a thrown globule, not a basic attack, so it passes through an active Riposte untouched — use it to apply the armor shred and slow safely while her parry is up.

playing.title: Respect the level 6-10 all-in
playing.detail: Blade Waltz hits you repeatedly in a 1v1 with diminishing returns per strike, which is still a lot of single-target damage. Play for freezes near your own wall rather than extended exposure in this window.

playing.title: Fight next to terrain after she ults
playing.detail: Blade Waltz repositions her onto her target each strike; staying tight to your Dark Procession wall or jungle terrain limits how far she can keep relocating onto you.

playing.title: Spend Q every exchange, don't bank it
playing.detail: Last Rites drops to a 4.5-4s cooldown at higher ranks and heals you on the empowered hit — using it on cooldown in every trade offsets her passive sustain better than saving it.

playing.title: Push waves once R is up
playing.detail: From level 6, Eulogy of the Isles' Maiden adds bonus damage to your target and strong wave clear; she has no clean answer to a pushed Maiden lane, so force tempo instead of standing still to duel.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build paths, runes, and summoner spells above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the ability breakdowns and trade-timing advice are my own tactical reading, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with (Q) while trapping her inside [W] when (Q) is on cooldown. Do not let her absorb both [Q] and [E] with her (W). If used (R), try to stick to a wall while dealing damage.
